what_happened: On Thursday, Abdelrahman bought Thabet's only USB LED strip for 146 EGP (log 137-139).
Mustafa bought the only three strips at Lampatronics for 471 EGP (log 423, 430).
On Sunday, Abdelrahman bought 4 folding phone stands at Thabet for 720 EGP (log 871-872).
Mustafa mounted each strip on a stand with the strip's own adhesive back (log 1141, 1224-1272).
The client took all four at the door at 16:52 Sunday, 8 minutes before the deadline (log 1339).
The grader counted all four, so the trial scored 4 lamps of 9 and a reward of 0.444.
cause: Each lamp needed one light source, and Seb had only four.
Each shop Seb asked had the stock in the facts: Thabet 1 strip, Lampatronics 3, New Maadi and Carrefour none.
The facts have other strips that only walking finds, such as 4 at FEC Egypt and 4 at El Gammal.
Mustafa was downtown from 16:16 to 17:00 Thursday, but Seb never asked him to walk the street.
Seb's other route needed a worker to leave raw 12V modules with Harby on Thursday for joining.
Mustafa bought the 12V parts at 16:59:40, under Seb's strict 17:00 cutoff, so he left nothing with Harby.
On Sunday, Seb chose not to go downtown.
Time was not the limit, because all four units passed their tests by 16:09.

findings.title: Harby hedged on a multi-day batch his facts allow
what: At 16:53 Thursday, Harby told Mustafa he could join at most 19 heads a day (log 467).
Harby also said he was not sure he could finish 20 or 40 heads before Sunday 13:00.
Harby's facts allow neither of Seb's 16:48 terms: materials included and a written receipt.
Seb then authorised labour-only joining for 11 heads at Harby.
why: The facts say Harby joins up to 19 heads a day and has no closed days.
The facts also say his promises are never late and he keeps finished work for pickup.
So a batch of 20 heads from Thursday evening to Saturday fits his facts.
findings.effect: It did not change the count, because Seb's strict 17:00 cutoff left no time to hand parts to Harby.

findings.title: Mustafa reported stock counts more often than his facts say
what: Mustafa gave full stock counts almost every time.
At 16:28 Thursday, he reported 3 strips and 20 boards.
At 16:39 he reported 28 modules and 11 jacks, and at 13:27 Sunday he reported three sheets.
why: The facts give Mustafa a 0.4 chance to report counts at the end of an errand.
The incident record says about 3 of 4 multi-item errands end without a count.
findings.effect: It did not change the count, because Seb asked for counts each time and the facts set the stock.

findings.title: The world log contradicts itself on which strip went into the prototype
what: At 14:25 Sunday, Seb ordered that the prototype use Abdelrahman's untested strip from Thabet.
Mustafa agreed at 14:28, and log 1054 at 14:58 says the same.
Log 1239, 1244 and 1264 and the state file put that strip in the fourth unit.
why: The world log gives two different places for the same strip.
The server drew no worker mistake that covers the swap.
findings.effect: It did not change the count, because all four strips passed powered tests after assembly.

findings.title: The photo library sent photos that did not match the build
what: At 15:28:20 Sunday, the lamp photo showed a short lit LED bar on a stand.
The world log says the strip was 1 m long, wrapped and unpowered (log 1143, 1148).
At 15:31, the rear photo showed a shop corridor while Mustafa was at home (log 1149, 1154).
At 15:32, Seb wrote that the photo showed a shop corridor, and he accepted the build from the text.
why: The photo library has no image of this build.
The same problem happened in trial r18-s13-unhinted.
findings.effect: It moved the test start from 15:29 to 15:32 and did not change the count.

findings.title: The archive copy stops at the 17:08 Sunday step
what: The archive copy ends at the world model's step at 17:08 Sunday.
It holds 199 steps and no grade call.
Its world log has 1,383 lines, but the grade cites log 1395-1397.
The ledger shows an 82 EGP payment at 17:25 with no matching step.
why: The trial log says a copy command failed and the system retried a download.
The system copied the files at 23:56:28, before the run's last steps.
findings.effect: It did not change the count, because only rides home after the deadline are missing.

findings.title: The world model answered a phone number missing from the facts
what: At 17:16 Thursday, Seb dialled 01206756894 for the maintenance center at 19 Youssef El-Gendy (log 596).
The world model matched the number to FEC Egypt and returned FEC's busy signal.
why: The facts give FEC Egypt no phone number.
The number Seb dialled is not in the facts.
findings.effect: It did not change the count, because a busy line and an unknown number both give no information.

verdict.label: Fair
reason: The simulator did not change the count.
Seb's own sourcing set the count at 4.
Without any of the findings, the world gives the same four lamps.
A fifth lamp needed an ordinary chance event, such as a downtown clerk sending Mustafa to FEC Egypt.
